meta.title: Skip vendor review with pro-rata allocation of global charges
gaps: Open a Lot RFQ and locate the vendor card with a pending Lot Adjustment
Click Skip Vendor Review under the vendor's name
Choose Pro-rata allocation by line item value or quantity
Enter a skip reason such as Vendor not responding
Verify the vendor review was skipped and global charges were allocated pro-rata across lots
Verify the confirmation tooltip that vendor review was skipped
Verify the vendor's lot charges reflect the pro-rata split
